case.subject: JPW Industries
case.problem: Manual customer order processing could take 16 to 24 hours.
case.workflow: Agentforce assists order processing using connected business data. The announcement describes agents that retrieve data and perform configured actions; it does not disclose every step in JPW’s implementation or its exact human approval rules.
case.result: JPW reports order processing below one hour and case resolution time reduced by almost 40% while workload increased 15%.
case.result_basis: Company testimony from Terri Eshleman, published by vendor Salesforce; not an independent controlled study.
case.measurement_context: Before/after company report; measurement period and sample size are not disclosed.
case.source_quote: Now with Agentforce, we’ve reduced that time to less than an hour.
case.limitation: Results are company-reported and do not establish what another business will achieve. The page does not specify JPW’s complete workflow or approval rules.
case.listener_action: Time one repetitive order-intake task and evaluate a small supervised pilot with human review of errors.
case.availability: Historical 2025 case; supporting Salesforce announcement remains accessible as checked 2026-10-27. Confirm current product availability directly before procurement.
